CATEGORY: 把 / 被 (Grammar)
definition: Use 把 for an initiated disposal action, usually with a result or completion; use 被 for passive voice. Do not use 把 when the subject did not cause the event.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (6 distinct):
1 | “把”usually ends with了
1 | “把“ is used for initiated actions (“disposal”), here it is not he who threw those pears, but the pears fell themselves. 倒 means “pour” if it is an initiated action, and means “fall” if it is not an initiated action, and followed by 下去/下来。
1 | 被 means passive voice “be done”
1 | 把Obj. V. Resultative complement
1 | avoid “生病的朋友“ and “灵芝” close to each other
1 | to avoid “他” and “地上像……的植物” too close to each other

HER CORRECTIONS (9 of 9):
[pear_story#2/f6/p0/k0/e0] 把帽子[弄掉→弄掉了]  || her note: “把”usually ends with了
[pear_story#3/f8/p1/note/e0] ⟦他把梨从筐里倒出去⟧  || her note: “把“ is used for initiated actions (“disposal”), here it is not he who threw those pears, but the pears fell themselves. 倒 means “pour” if it is an initiated action, and means “fall” if it is not an initiated action, and followed by 下去/下来。
[pear_story#2/f7/p0/k0/e0] [被→]筐里的梨子坐在地上了  || her note: 被 means passive voice “be done”
[pear_story#3/f3/p0/k0/e0] 他用他的围巾[擦，把梨干净→把梨擦干净]  || her note: 把Obj. V. Resultative complement
[shennong_samples#17/f7/p0/k0/e0] 然后神农[给生病朋友灵芝→把灵芝拿给生病的朋友]  || her note: avoid “生病的朋友“ and “灵芝” close to each other
[shennong_samples#47/f9/p2/k0/e0] 得问男人[给他地方上像蘑菇一样的植物吃了→把地上像蘑菇一样的植物给他吃了]  || her note: to avoid “他” and “地上像……的植物” too close to each other
[pear_story#3/f8/p0/k0/e0] [-他把]梨从筐里倒出去
[shennong_samples#14/f7/p0/k0/e0] 所以他[把灵芝→用灵芝]治好了他的朋友们
[shennong_samples#41/f5/p0/k0/e0] [叫了这个对身体有好处的植物→把这个对身体有好处的植物叫做]灵芝

output.rule: Use 把 for an initiated action that disposes of an object: 把Obj. V. Resultative complement, usually ending with 了. Use 被 for passive voice (“be done”), not for an active or self-happening event.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject> <does/does not initiate> the action. Use <把Obj. V. Resultative complement + 了 / 被 / no 把> because <object> is <disposed of / passively affected / doing the action by itself>.

examples.explanation: 把帽子弄掉 → 把帽子弄掉了: this is a completed 把 action, so it usually ends with 了.
他把梨从筐里倒出去: do not use 把 because he did not initiate throwing the pears; the pears fell themselves, so use 倒下去/倒下来.
被筐里的梨子坐在地上了 → 筐里的梨子坐在地上了: 被 means passive voice, “be done,” so do not use it here.
擦，把梨干净 → 把梨擦干净: put the object after 把 and use the resultative complement: 把Obj. V. Resultative complement.
叫了这个对身体有好处的植物灵芝 → 把这个对身体有好处的植物叫做灵芝: use 把 to show the initiated action of naming the plant.

output.not_an_error: Do not use 把 when the subject did not cause the event, such as when the pears fell themselves. Do not flag 被 unless passive voice (“be done”) is intended.
